units.leftText: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,
units.rightText: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show unto his servants, even the things which must shortly come to pass: and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John;
leftNotes: 1:1 Or suddenly or quickly

units.leftText: who testifies to everything he saw. This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: who bare witness of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, even of all things that he saw.

units.leftText: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear and obey what is written in it, because the time is near. John Greets the Seven Churches
units.rightText: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written therein: for the time is at hand.

units.leftText: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia:
units.rightText: John to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from him who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits that are before his throne;
leftNotes: 1:4 Literally in Asia; Asia was a Roman province in what is now western Turkey.

units.leftText: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth.
units.rightText: and from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loveth us, and loosed us from our sins by his blood;

units.leftText: who has made us to be a kingdom, priests to His God and Father — to Him be the glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
units.rightText: and he made us to be a kingdom, to be priests unto his God and Father; to him be the glory and the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

units.leftText: Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him — even those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. So shall it be! Amen.
units.rightText: Behold, he cometh with the clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they that pierced him; and all the tribes of the earth shall mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

units.leftText: “I am the Alpha and the Omega, ” says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come — the Almighty. John’s Vision on Patmos
units.rightText: I am the Alpha and the Omega, saith the Lord God, who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.
leftNotes: 1:8 TR the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End

units.leftText: I, John, your brother and partner in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus.
units.rightText: I John, your brother and partaker with you in the tribulation and kingdom and patience which are in Jesus, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.

units.leftText: On the Lord’s day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,
units.rightText: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet

units.leftText: saying, “Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
units.rightText: saying, What thou seest, write in a book and send it to the seven churches: unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamum, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
leftNotes: 1:11 TR saying, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last,” and,

units.leftText: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,
units.rightText: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And having turned I saw seven golden candlesticks;

units.leftText: and among the lampstands was One like the Son of Man, dressed in a long robe, with a golden sash around His chest.
units.rightText: and in the midst of the candlesticks one like unto a son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about at the breasts with a golden girdle.
leftNotes: 1:13 Or one like a son of man; see Daniel 7:13|DAN 7:13*.

units.leftText: The hair of His head was white like wool, as white as snow, and His eyes were like a blazing fire.
units.rightText: And his head and his hair were white as white wool, white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;

units.leftText: His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and His voice was like the roar of many waters.
units.rightText: and his feet like unto burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace; and his voice as the voice of many waters.

units.leftText: He held in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
units.rightText: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.

units.leftText: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. But He placed His right hand on me and said, “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,
units.rightText: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as one dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying, Fear not; I am the first and the last,

units.leftText: the Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.
units.rightText: and the Living one; and I was dead, and behold, I am alive for evermore, and I have the keys of death and of Hades.

units.leftText: Therefore write down the things you have seen, the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.
units.rightText: Write therefore the things which thou sawest, and the things which are, and the things which shall come to pass hereafter;

units.leftText: This is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand and of the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.[’’]
units.rightText: the mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks are seven churches.

units.leftText: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of Him who holds the seven stars in His right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.
units.rightText: To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, he that walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks:

units.leftText: I know your deeds, your labor, and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil, and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.
units.rightText: I know thy works, and thy toil and patience, and that thou canst not bear evil men, and didst try them that call themselves apostles, and they are not, and didst find them false;

units.leftText: Without growing weary, you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of My name.
units.rightText: and thou hast patience and didst bear for my name’s sake, and hast not grown weary.

units.leftText: But I have this against you: You have abandoned your first love.
units.rightText: But I have this against thee, that thou didst leave thy first love.

units.leftText: Therefore, keep in mind how far you have fallen. Repent and perform the deeds you did at first. But if you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
units.rightText: Remember therefore whence thou art fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I come to thee, and will move thy candlestick out of its place, except thou repent.

units.leftText: But you have this to your credit: You hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
units.rightText: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

units.leftText: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God. To the Church in Smyrna
units.rightText: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches. To him that overcometh, to him will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.

units.leftText: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life.
units.rightText: And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These things saith the first and the last, who was dead, and lived again:

units.leftText: I know your affliction and your poverty — though you are rich! And I am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be Jews, but are in fact a synagogue of Satan.
units.rightText: I know thy tribulation, and thy poverty (but thou art rich), and the blasphemy of them that say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

units.leftText: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days. Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
units.rightText: Fear not the things which thou art about to suffer: behold, the devil is about to cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days. Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee the crown of life.

units.leftText: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death. To the Church in Pergamum
units.rightText: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches. He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.

units.leftText: To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of the One who holds the sharp, double-edged sword.
units.rightText: And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These things saith he that hath the sharp two-edged sword:

units.leftText: I know where you live, where the throne of Satan sits, yet you hold fast to My name. You did not deny your faith in Me, even in the days of My faithful witness Antipas, who was killed among you where Satan dwells.
units.rightText: I know where thou dwellest, even where Satan’s throne is; and thou holdest fast my name, and didst not deny my faith, even in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwelleth.

units.leftText: But I have a few things against you, because some of you hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.
units.rightText: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there some that hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit fornication.

units.leftText: In the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
units.rightText: So hast thou also some that hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans in like manner.

units.leftText: Therefore repent! Otherwise I will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
units.rightText: Repent therefore; or else I come to thee quickly, and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

units.leftText: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it. To the Church in Thyatira (Acts 16:11–15|ACT 16:11-15*)
units.rightText: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches. To him that overcometh, to him will I give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and upon the stone a new name written, which no one knoweth but he that receiveth it.

units.leftText: To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.
units.rightText: And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like unto burnished brass:

units.leftText: I know your deeds — your love, your faith, your service, your perseverance — and your latest deeds are greater than your first.
units.rightText: I know thy works, and thy love and faith and ministry and patience, and that thy last works are more than the first.

units.leftText: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads My servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
units.rightText: But I have this against thee, that thou sufferest the woman Jezebel, who calleth herself a prophetess; and she teacheth and seduceth my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed to idols.

units.leftText: Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling.
units.rightText: And I gave her time that she should repent; and she willeth not to repent of her fornication.

units.leftText: Behold, I will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless they repent of her deeds.
units.rightText: Behold, I cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of her works.

units.leftText: Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
units.rightText: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he that searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto each one of you according to your works.

units.leftText: But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan: I will place no further burden upon you
units.rightText: But to you I say, to the rest that are in Thyatira, as many as have not this teaching, who know not the deep things of Satan, as they are wont to say; I cast upon you none other burden.

units.leftText: than to hold fast to what you have until I come.
units.rightText: Nevertheless that which ye have, hold fast till I come.

units.leftText: And to the one who overcomes and continues in My work until the end, I will give authority over the nations.
units.rightText: And he that overcometh, and he that keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give authority over the nations:

units.leftText: He will rule them with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery — just as I have received authority from My Father.
units.rightText: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron, as the vessels of the potter are broken to shivers; as I also have received of my Father:
leftNotes: 2:27 Psalm 2:9|PSA 2:9* (see also LXX)

units.leftText: And I will give him the morning star.
units.rightText: and I will give him the morning star.

units.leftText: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.[’’]
units.rightText: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

units.leftText: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars.
units.rightText: And to the angel of the church in Sardis write: These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars: I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and thou art dead.
leftNotes: 3:1 Or the sevenfold Spirit

units.leftText: Wake up and strengthen what remains, which is about to die; for I have found your deeds incomplete in the sight of My God.
units.rightText: Be thou watchful, and establish the things that remain, which were ready to die: for I have found no works of thine perfected before my God.

units.leftText: Remember, then, what you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know the hour when I will come upon you.
units.rightText: Remember therefore how thou hast received and didst hear; and keep it, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.

units.leftText: But you do have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their garments, and because they are worthy, they will walk with Me in white.
units.rightText: But thou hast a few names in Sardis that did not defile their garments: and they shall walk with me in white; for they are worthy.

units.leftText: Like them, he who overcomes will be dressed in white. And I will never blot out his name from the Book of Life, but I will confess his name before My Father and His angels.
units.rightText: He that overcometh shall thus be arrayed in white garments; and I will in no wise blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
leftNotes: 3:5 Or scrape off

units.leftText: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the Church in Philadelphia
units.rightText: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

units.leftText: To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open.
units.rightText: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth and none shall shut, and that shutteth and none openeth:
leftNotes: 3:7 See Isaiah 22:22|ISA 22:22*.

units.leftText: I know your deeds. Behold, I have placed before you an open door, which no one can shut. I know that you have only a little strength, yet you have kept My word and have not denied My name.
units.rightText: I know thy works (behold, I have set before thee a door opened, which none can shut), that thou hast a little power, and didst keep my word, and didst not deny my name.

units.leftText: As for those who belong to the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are liars instead, I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I love you.
units.rightText: Behold, I give of the synagogue of Satan, of them that say they are Jews, and they are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.

units.leftText: Because you have kept My command to persevere, I will also keep you from the hour of testing that is about to come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
units.rightText: Because thou didst keep the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of trial, that hour which is to come upon the whole world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

units.leftText: I am coming soon. Hold fast to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
units.rightText: I come quickly: hold fast that which thou hast, that no one take thy crown.
leftNotes: 3:11 Or suddenly or quickly

units.leftText: The one who overcomes I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will never again leave it. Upon him I will write the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God (the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from My God), and My new name.
units.rightText: He that overcometh, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go out thence no more: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God, and mine own new name.

units.leftText: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the Church in Laodicea (Colossians 2:1–5|COL 2:1-5*)
units.rightText: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

units.leftText: To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God’s creation.
units.rightText: And to the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God:
leftNotes: 3:14 Or Beginning or Ruler

units.leftText: I know your deeds; you are neither cold nor hot. How I wish you were one or the other!
units.rightText: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.

units.leftText: So because you are lukewarm — neither hot nor cold — I am about to vomit you out of My mouth!
units.rightText: So because thou art lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will spew thee out of my mouth.

units.leftText: You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
units.rightText: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art the wretched one and miserable and poor and blind and naked:

units.leftText: I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, white garments so that you may be clothed and your shameful nakedness not exposed, and salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see.
units.rightText: I counsel thee to buy of me gold refined by fire, that thou mayest become rich; and white garments, that thou mayest clothe thyself, and that the shame of thy nakedness be not made manifest; and eyesalve to anoint thine eyes, that thou mayest see.

units.leftText: Those I love I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
units.rightText: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.

units.leftText: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.
units.rightText: Behold, I stand at the door and knock: if any man hear my voice and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

units.leftText: To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
units.rightText: He that overcometh, I will give to him to sit down with me in my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father in his throne.

units.leftText: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”
units.rightText: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

units.leftText: After this I looked and saw a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had previously heard speak to me like a trumpet was saying, “Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after these things.”
units.rightText: After these things I saw, and behold, a door opened in heaven, and the first voice that I heard, a voice as of a trumpet speaking with me, one saying, Come up hither, and I will show thee the things which must come to pass hereafter.

units.leftText: At once I was in the Spirit, and I saw a throne standing in heaven, with someone seated on it.
units.rightText: Straightway I was in the Spirit: and behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting upon the throne;

units.leftText: The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne.
units.rightText: and he that sat was to look upon like a jasper stone and a sardius: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, like an emerald to look upon.

units.leftText: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on these thrones sat twenty-four elders dressed in white, with golden crowns on their heads. Worship of the Creator
units.rightText: And round about the throne were four and twenty thrones: and upon the thrones I saw four and twenty elders sitting, arrayed in white garments; and on their heads crowns of gold.

units.leftText: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings, and peals of thunder. Before the throne burned seven torches of fire. These are the seven spirits of God.
units.rightText: And out of the throne proceed lightnings and voices and thunders. And there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God;
leftNotes: 4:5 Or This is the sevenfold Spirit

units.leftText: And before the throne was something like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, covered with eyes in front and back.
units.rightText: and before the throne, as it were a sea of glass like unto crystal; and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

units.leftText: The first living creature was like a lion, the second like a calf, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.
units.rightText: And the first creature was like a lion, and the second creature like a calf, and the third creature had a face as of a man, and the fourth creature was like a flying eagle.

units.leftText: And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”
units.rightText: And the four living creatures, having each one of them six wings, are full of eyes round about and within: and they have no rest day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come.

units.leftText: And whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne, who lives forever and ever,
units.rightText: And when the living creatures shall give glory and honor and thanks to him that sitteth on the throne, to him that liveth for ever and ever,

units.leftText: the twenty-four elders fall down before the One seated on the throne, and they worship Him who lives forever and ever. They cast their crowns before the throne, saying:
units.rightText: the four and twenty elders shall fall down before him that sitteth on the throne, and shall worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and shall cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

units.leftText: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and were created.”
units.rightText: Worthy art thou, our Lord and our God, to receive the glory and the honor and the power: for thou didst create all things, and because of thy will they were, and were created.

units.leftText: Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the One seated on the throne. It had writing on both sides and was sealed with seven seals.
units.rightText: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the back, close sealed with seven seals.

units.leftText: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?”
units.rightText: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a great voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?

units.leftText: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
units.rightText: And no one in the heaven, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book, or to look thereon.

units.leftText: And I began to weep bitterly, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
units.rightText: And I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book, or to look thereon:

units.leftText: Then one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep! Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals.”
units.rightText: and one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not; behold, the Lion that is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, hath overcome to open the book and the seven seals thereof.

units.leftText: Then I saw a Lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
units.rightText: And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns, and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent forth into all the earth.
leftNotes: 5:6 Or the sevenfold Spirit

units.leftText: And He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the One seated on the throne.
units.rightText: And he came, and he taketh it out of the right hand of him that sat on the throne.

units.leftText: When He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp, and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
units.rightText: And when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having each one a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

units.leftText: And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
units.rightText: And they sing a new song, saying, Worthy art thou to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and didst purchase unto God with thy blood men of every tribe, and tongue, and people, and nation,

units.leftText: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign upon the earth.” The Lamb Exalted
units.rightText: and madest them to be unto our God a kingdom and priests; and they reign upon the earth.
leftNotes: 5:10 Or they will reign over; WH they reign upon

units.leftText: Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels encircling the throne, and the living creatures and the elders. And their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands.
units.rightText: And I saw, and I heard a voice of many angels round about the throne and the living creatures and the elders; and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

units.leftText: In a loud voice they were saying: “Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!”
units.rightText: saying with a great voice, Worthy is the Lamb that hath been slain to receive the power, and riches, and wisdom, and might, and honor, and glory, and blessing.

units.leftText: And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!”
units.rightText: And every created thing which is in the heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and on the sea, and all things that are in them, heard I saying, Unto him that sitteth on the throne, and unto the Lamb, be the blessing, and the honor, and the glory, and the dominion, for ever and ever.

units.leftText: And the four living creatures said, “Amen,” and the elders fell down and worshiped.
units.rightText: And the four living creatures said, Amen. And the elders fell down and worshipped.
leftNotes: 5:14 TR includes Him who lives for ever and ever.

units.leftText: Then I watched as the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, “Come!”
units.rightText: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying as with a voice of thunder, Come.

units.leftText: So I looked and saw a white horse, and its rider held a bow. And he was given a crown, and he rode out to overcome and conquer. The Second Seal: War
units.rightText: And I saw, and behold, a white horse, and he that sat thereon had a bow; and there was given unto him a crown: and he came forth conquering, and to conquer.

units.leftText: And when the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come!”
units.rightText: And when he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, Come.

units.leftText: Then another horse went forth. It was bright red, and its rider was granted permission to take away peace from the earth and to make men slay one another. And he was given a great sword. The Third Seal: Famine
units.rightText: And another horse came forth, a red horse: and to him that sat thereon it was given to take peace from the earth, and that they should slay one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.

units.leftText: And when the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come!”
units.rightText: And when he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, Come. And I saw, and behold, a black horse; and he that sat thereon had a balance in his hand.

units.leftText: And I heard what sounded like a voice from among the four living creatures, saying, “A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius, and do not harm the oil and wine.” The Fourth Seal: Death
units.rightText: And I heard as it were a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, A measure of wheat for a shilling, and three measures of barley for a shilling; and the oil and the wine hurt thou not.
leftNotes: 6:6 Greek A choenix of wheat for a denarius.A choenix was a Greek dry measure equivalent to 1.92 pints or 0.91 liters. A denarius was customarily a day’s wage for a laborer; see Matthew 20:2|MAT 20:2*.

units.leftText: And when the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come!”
units.rightText: And when he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, Come.

units.leftText: Then I looked and saw a pale green horse. Its rider’s name was Death, and Hades followed close behind. And they were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth. The Fifth Seal: The Martyrs
units.rightText: And I saw, and behold, a pale horse: and he that sat upon him, his name was Death; and Hades followed with him. And there was given unto them authority over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with famine, and with death, and by the wild beasts of the earth.

units.leftText: And when the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony they had upheld.
units.rightText: And when he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of them that had been slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:

units.leftText: And they cried out in a loud voice, “How long, O Lord, holy and true, until You judge those who dwell upon the earth and avenge our blood?”
units.rightText: and they cried with a great voice, saying, How long, O Master, the holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

units.leftText: Then each of them was given a white robe and told to rest a little while longer until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers, were killed, just as they had been killed. The Sixth Seal: Terror
units.rightText: And there was given them to each one a white robe; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little time, until their fellow-servants also and their brethren, who should be killed even as they were, should have fulfilled their course.

units.leftText: And I watched as the Lamb opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black like sackcloth of goat hair, and the whole moon turned blood red,
units.rightText: And I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the whole moon became as blood;

units.leftText: and the stars of the sky fell to the earth like unripe figs dropping from a tree shaken by a great wind.
units.rightText: and the stars of the heaven fell unto the earth, as a fig tree casteth her unripe figs when she is shaken of a great wind.

units.leftText: The sky receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.
units.rightText: And the heaven was removed as a scroll when it is rolled up; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

units.leftText: Then the kings of the earth, the nobles, the commanders, the rich, the mighty, and every slave and free man hid in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
units.rightText: And the kings of the earth, and the princes, and the chief captains, and the rich, and the strong, and every bondman and freeman, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains;

units.leftText: And they said to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of the One seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb.
units.rightText: and they say to the mountains and to the rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
leftNotes: 6:16 See Hosea 10:8|HOS 10:8*.

units.leftText: For the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to withstand it?”
units.rightText: for the great day of their wrath is come; and who is able to stand?
leftNotes: 6:17 BYZ and TR His

units.leftText: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back its four winds so that no wind would blow on land or sea or on any tree.
units.rightText: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that no wind should blow on the earth, or on the sea, or upon any tree.

units.leftText: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, with the seal of the living God. And he called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:
units.rightText: And I saw another angel ascend from the sunrising, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a great voice to the four angels to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

units.leftText: “Do not harm the land or sea or trees until we have placed a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
units.rightText: saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we shall have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads.

units.leftText: And I heard the number of those who were sealed, 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel:
units.rightText: And I heard the number of them that were sealed, a hundred and forty and four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

units.leftText: From the tribe of Judah 12,000 were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben 12,000, from the tribe of Gad 12,000,
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Judah were sealed twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand;

units.leftText: from the tribe of Asher 12,000, from the tribe of Naphtali 12,000, from the tribe of Manasseh 12,000,
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand;

units.leftText: from the tribe of Simeon 12,000, from the tribe of Levi 12,000, from the tribe of Issachar 12,000,
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand;

units.leftText: from the tribe of Zebulun 12,000, from the tribe of Joseph 12,000, and from the tribe of Benjamin 12,000. Praise from the Great Multitude
units.rightText: Of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.

units.leftText: After this I looked and saw a multitude too large to count, from every nation and tribe and people and tongue, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.
units.rightText: After these things I saw, and behold, a great multitude, which no man could number, out of every nation and of all tribes and peoples and tongues, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, arrayed in white robes, and palms in their hands;

units.leftText: And they cried out in a loud voice: “Salvation to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
units.rightText: and they cry with a great voice, saying, Salvation unto our God who sitteth on the throne, and unto the Lamb.

units.leftText: And all the angels stood around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. And they fell facedown before the throne and worshiped God,
units.rightText: And all the angels were standing round about the throne, and about the elders and the four living creatures; and they fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,

units.leftText: saying, “Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
units.rightText: saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honor, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.

units.leftText: Then one of the elders addressed me: “These in white robes,” he asked, “who are they, and where have they come from?”
units.rightText: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, These that are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and whence came they?

units.leftText: “Sir,” I answered, “you know.”
units.rightText: And I say unto him, My lord, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they that come out of the great tribulation, and they washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

units.leftText: For this reason, they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
units.rightText: Therefore are they before the throne of God; and they serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall spread his tabernacle over them.

units.leftText: ‘Never again will they hunger, and never will they thirst; nor will the sun beat down upon them, nor any scorching heat.’
units.rightText: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun strike upon them, nor any heat:

units.leftText: For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ and ‘God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’ ”
units.rightText: for the Lamb that is in the midst of the throne shall be their shepherd, and shall guide them unto fountains of waters of life: and God shall wipe away every tear from their eyes.
leftNotes: 7:17 See Psalm 23:1|PSA 23:1*.

units.leftText: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
units.rightText: And when he opened the seventh seal, there followed a silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

units.leftText: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets.
units.rightText: And I saw the seven angels that stand before God; and there were given unto them seven trumpets.

units.leftText: Then another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, along with the prayers of all the saints, on the golden altar before the throne.
units.rightText: And another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should add it unto the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

units.leftText: And the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints, rose up before God from the hand of the angel.
units.rightText: And the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

units.leftText: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it to the earth; and there were peals of thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning, and an earthquake. The First Four Trumpets
units.rightText: And the angel taketh the censer; and he filled it with the fire of the altar, and cast it upon the earth: and there followed thunders, and voices, and lightnings, and an earthquake.

units.leftText: And the seven angels with the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.
units.rightText: And the seven angels that had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

units.leftText: Then the first angel sounded his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood were hurled down upon the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, along with a third of the trees and all the green grass.
units.rightText: And the first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of the earth was burnt up, and the third part of the trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

units.leftText: Then the second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
units.rightText: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;

units.leftText: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
units.rightText: and there died the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, even they that had life; and the third part of the ships was destroyed.

units.leftText: Then the third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star burning like a torch fell from heaven and landed on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
units.rightText: And the third angel sounded, and there fell from heaven a great star, burning as a torch, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of the waters;

units.leftText: The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter like wormwood oil, and many people died from the bitter waters.
units.rightText: and the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.
leftNotes: 8:11 Literally became wormwood

units.leftText: Then the fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun and moon and stars were struck. A third of the stars were darkened, a third of the day was without light, and a third of the night as well.
units.rightText: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; that the third part of them should be darkened, and the day should not shine for the third part of it, and the night in like manner.

units.leftText: And as I observed, I heard an eagle flying overhead, calling in a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the remaining three angels!”
units.rightText: And I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a great voice, Woe, woe, woe, for them that dwell on the earth, by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, who are yet to sound.

units.leftText: Then the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth, and it was given the key to the pit of the Abyss.
units.rightText: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from heaven fallen unto the earth: and there was given to him the key of the pit of the abyss.

units.leftText: The star opened the pit of the Abyss, and smoke rose out of it like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke from the pit.
units.rightText: And he opened the pit of the abyss; and there went up a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.

units.leftText: And out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth, and they were given power like that of the scorpions of the earth.
units.rightText: And out of the smoke came forth locusts upon the earth; and power was given them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

units.leftText: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
units.rightText: And it was said unto them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only such men as have not the seal of God on their foreheads.

units.leftText: The locusts were not given power to kill them, but only to torment them for five months, and their torment was like the stinging of a scorpion.
units.rightText: And it was given them that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when it striketh a man.

units.leftText: In those days men will seek death and will not find it; they will long to die, but death will escape them.
units.rightText: And in those days men shall seek death, and shall in no wise find it; and they shall desire to die, and death fleeth from them.

units.leftText: And the locusts looked like horses prepared for battle, with something like crowns of gold on their heads; and their faces were like the faces of men.
units.rightText: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared for war; and upon their heads as it were crowns like unto gold, and their faces were as men’s faces.

units.leftText: They had hair like that of women, and teeth like those of lions.
units.rightText: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.

units.leftText: They also had breastplates like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the roar of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
units.rightText: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots, of many horses rushing to war.

units.leftText: They had tails with stingers like scorpions, which had the power to injure people for five months.
units.rightText: And they have tails like unto scorpions, and stings; and in their tails is their power to hurt men five months.

units.leftText: They were ruled by a king, the angel of the Abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek it is Apollyon.
units.rightText: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss: his name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in the Greek tongue he hath the name Apollyon.
leftNotes: 9:11 Abaddon means Destruction.
9:11 Apollyon means Destroyer.

units.leftText: The first woe has passed. Behold, two woes are still to follow. The Sixth Trumpet
units.rightText: The first Woe is past: behold, there come yet two Woes hereafter.

units.leftText: Then the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God
units.rightText: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

units.leftText: saying to the sixth angel with the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”
units.rightText: one saying to the sixth angel that had the trumpet, Loose the four angels that are bound at the great river Euphrates.

units.leftText: So the four angels who had been prepared for this hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.
units.rightText: And the four angels were loosed, that had been prepared for the hour and day and month and year, that they should kill the third part of men.

units.leftText: And the number of mounted troops was two hundred million; I heard their number.
units.rightText: And the number of the armies of the horsemen was twice ten thousand times ten thousand: I heard the number of them.

units.leftText: Now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this: The riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur. The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions, and out of their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur.
units.rightText: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates as of fire and of hyacinth and of brimstone: and the heads of the horses are as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths proceedeth fire and smoke and brimstone.

units.leftText: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke, and sulfur that proceeded from their mouths.
units.rightText: By these three plagues was the third part of men killed, by the fire and the smoke and the brimstone, which proceeded out of their mouths.

units.leftText: For the power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; indeed, their tails were like snakes, having heads with which to inflict harm.
units.rightText: For the power of the horses is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails are like unto serpents, and have heads; and with them they hurt.

units.leftText: Now the rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the works of their hands. They did not stop worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk.
units.rightText: And the rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood; which can neither see, nor hear, nor walk:

units.leftText: Furthermore, they did not repent of their murder, sorcery, sexual immorality, and theft.
units.rightText: and they repented not of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

units.leftText: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head. His face was like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire.
units.rightText: And I saw another strong angel coming down out of heaven, arrayed with a cloud; and the rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire;

units.leftText: He held in his hand a small scroll, which lay open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
units.rightText: and he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left upon the earth;

units.leftText: Then he cried out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion. And when he cried out, the seven thunders sounded their voices.
units.rightText: and he cried with a great voice, as a lion roareth: and when he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

units.leftText: When the seven thunders had spoken, I was about to put it in writing. But I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.”
units.rightText: And when the seven thunders uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying, Seal up the things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.

units.leftText: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to heaven.
units.rightText: And the angel that I saw standing upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his right hand to heaven,

units.leftText: And he swore by Him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and everything in it, the earth and everything in it, and the sea and everything in it: “There will be no more delay!
units.rightText: and sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created the heaven and the things that are therein, and the earth and the things that are therein, and the sea and the things that are therein, that there shall be delay no longer:

units.leftText: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he begins to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.”
units.rightText: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then is finished the mystery of God, according to the good tidings which he declared to his servants the prophets.

units.leftText: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me again, saying, “Go, take the small scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land.”
units.rightText: And the voice which I heard from heaven, I heard it again speaking with me, and saying, Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel that standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.

units.leftText: And I went to the angel and said, “Give me the small scroll.” “Take it and eat it,” he said. “It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
units.rightText: And I went unto the angel, saying unto him that he should give me the little book. And he saith unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but in thy mouth it shall be sweet as honey.
leftNotes: 10:9 See Numbers 5:24|NUM 5:24* and Ezekiel 3:3.

units.leftText: So I took the small scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth. But when I had eaten it, my stomach turned bitter.
units.rightText: And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and when I had eaten it, my belly was made bitter.

units.leftText: And they told me, “You must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.”
units.rightText: And they say unto me, Thou must prophesy again over many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.

units.leftText: Then I was given a measuring rod like a staff and was told, “Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count the number of worshipers there.
units.rightText: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and one said, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.

units.leftText: But exclude the courtyard outside the temple. Do not measure it, because it has been given over to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for 42 months.
units.rightText: And the court which is without the temple leave without, and measure it not; for it hath been given unto the nations: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.

units.leftText: And I will empower my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.”
units.rightText: And I will give unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.

units.leftText: These witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
units.rightText: These are the two olive trees and the two candlesticks, standing before the Lord of the earth.
leftNotes: 11:4 See Zechariah 4:14|ZEC 4:14*.

units.leftText: If anyone wants to harm them, fire proceeds from their mouths and devours their enemies. In this way, anyone who wants to harm them must be killed.
units.rightText: And if any man desireth to hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth and devoureth their enemies; and if any man shall desire to hurt them, in this manner must he be killed.

units.leftText: These witnesses have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall during the days of their prophecy, and power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish. The Witnesses Killed and Raised
units.rightText: These have the power to shut the heaven, that it rain not during the days of their prophecy: and they have power over the waters to turn them into blood, and to smite the earth with every plague, as often as they shall desire.

units.leftText: When the two witnesses have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the Abyss will wage war with them, and will overpower and kill them.
units.rightText: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that cometh up out of the abyss shall make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

units.leftText: Their bodies will lie in the street of the great city — figuratively called Sodom and Egypt — where their Lord was also crucified.
units.rightText: And their dead bodies lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

units.leftText: For three and a half days all peoples and tribes and tongues and nations will view their bodies and will not permit them to be laid in a tomb.
units.rightText: And from among the peoples and tribes and tongues and nations do men look upon their dead bodies three days and a half, and suffer not their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

units.leftText: And those who dwell on the earth will gloat over them and celebrate and send one another gifts, because these two prophets had tormented them.
units.rightText: And they that dwell on the earth rejoice over them, and make merry; and they shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwell on the earth.

units.leftText: But after the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered the two witnesses, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell upon those who saw them.
units.rightText: And after the three days and a half the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them that beheld them.

units.leftText: And the witnesses heard a loud voice from heaven saying, “Come up here.” And they went up to heaven in a cloud as their enemies watched them.
units.rightText: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they went up into heaven in the cloud; and their enemies beheld them.

units.leftText: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand were killed in the quake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
units.rightText: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell; and there were killed in the earthquake seven thousand persons: and the rest were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

units.leftText: The second woe has passed. Behold, the third woe is coming shortly. The Seventh Trumpet
units.rightText: The second Woe is past: behold, the third Woe cometh quickly.

units.leftText: Then the seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and loud voices called out in heaven: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever.”
units.rightText: And the seventh angel sounded; and there followed great voices in heaven, and they said, The kingdom of the world is become the kingdom of our Lord, and of his Christ: and he shall reign for ever and ever.

units.leftText: And the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped God,
units.rightText: And the four and twenty elders, who sit before God on their thrones, fell upon their faces and worshipped God,

units.leftText: saying: “We give thanks to You, O Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.
units.rightText: saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God, the Almighty, who art and who wast; because thou hast taken thy great power, and didst reign.
leftNotes: 11:17 TR includes and who is to come.

units.leftText: The nations were enraged, and Your wrath has come. The time has come to judge the dead and to reward Your servants the prophets, as well as the saints and those who fear Your name, both small and great— and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”
units.rightText: And the nations were wroth, and thy wrath came, and the time of the dead to be judged, and the time to give their reward to thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and to them that fear thy name, the small and the great; and to destroy them that destroy the earth.
leftNotes: 11:18 See Psalm 2:1|PSA 2:1*.
11:18 See Daniel 12:2|DAN 12:2*.

units.leftText: Then the temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant appeared in His temple. And there were flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.
units.rightText: And there was opened the temple of God that is in heaven; and there was seen in his temple the ark of his covenant; and there followed lightnings, and voices, and thunders, and an earthquake, and great hail.

units.leftText: And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed in the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
units.rightText: And a great sign was seen in heaven: a woman arrayed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars;

units.leftText: She was pregnant and crying out in the pain and agony of giving birth.
units.rightText: and she was with child; and she crieth out, travailing in birth, and in pain to be delivered.

units.leftText: Then another sign appeared in heaven: a huge red dragon with seven heads, ten horns, and seven royal crowns on his heads.
units.rightText: And there was seen another sign in heaven: and behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his heads seven diadems.

units.leftText: His tail swept a third of the stars from the sky, hurling them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, ready to devour her child as soon as she gave birth.
units.rightText: And his tail draweth the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon standeth before the woman that is about to be delivered, that when she is delivered he may devour her child.

units.leftText: And she gave birth to a son, a male child, who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter. And her child was caught up to God and to His throne.
units.rightText: And she was delivered of a son, a man child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and unto his throne.
leftNotes: 12:5 See Psalm 2:9|PSA 2:9* (see also LXX).

units.leftText: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where God had prepared a place for her to be nourished for 1,260 days. The War in Heaven
units.rightText: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that there they may nourish her a thousand two hundred and threescore days.

units.leftText: Then a war broke out in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.
units.rightText: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels going forth to war with the dragon; and the dragon warred and his angels;

units.leftText: But the dragon was not strong enough, and no longer was any place found in heaven for him and his angels.
units.rightText: and they prevailed not, neither was their place found any more in heaven.

units.leftText: And the great dragon was hurled down — that ancient serpent called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.
units.rightText: And the great dragon was cast down, the old serpent, he that is called the Devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world; he was cast down to the earth, and his angels were cast down with him.

units.leftText: And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying: “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down — he who accuses them day and night before our God.
units.rightText: And I heard a great voice in heaven, saying, Now is come the salvation, and the power, and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, who accuseth them before our God day and night.

units.leftText: They have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony. And they did not love their lives so as to shy away from death.
units.rightText: And they overcame him because of the blood of the Lamb, and because of the word of their testimony; and they loved not their life even unto death.

units.leftText: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea; with great fury the devil has come down to you, knowing he has only a short time.” The Woman Persecuted
units.rightText: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe for the earth and for the sea: because the devil is gone down unto you, having great wrath, knowing that he hath but a short time.

units.leftText: And when the dragon saw that he had been thrown to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
units.rightText: And when the dragon saw that he was cast down to the earth, he persecuted the woman that brought forth the man child.

units.leftText: But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle to fly from the presence of the serpent to her place in the wilderness, where she was nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
units.rightText: And there were given to the woman the two wings of the great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness unto her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

units.leftText: Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river to overtake the woman and sweep her away in the torrent.
units.rightText: And the serpent cast out of his mouth after the woman water as a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

units.leftText: But the earth helped the woman and opened its mouth to swallow up the river that the dragon had poured from his mouth.
units.rightText: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon cast out of his mouth.

units.leftText: And the dragon was enraged at the woman and went to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus. And the dragon stood on the shore of the sea.
units.rightText: And the dragon waxed wroth with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her seed, that keep the commandments of God, and hold the testimony of Jesus:
leftNotes: 12:17 Literally And he stood on the sand of the sea. BYZ and TR And I stood on the sand of the sea.Some texts number this sentence as verse 18; others include it with Revelation 13:1|REV 13:1*.

units.leftText: Then I saw a beast with ten horns and seven heads rising out of the sea. There were ten royal crowns on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.
units.rightText: and he stood upon the sand of the sea. And I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads, and on his horns ten diadems, and upon his heads names of blasphemy.

units.leftText: The beast I saw was like a leopard, with the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.
units.rightText: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his throne, and great authority.

units.leftText: One of the heads of the beast appeared to have been mortally wounded. But the mortal wound was healed, and the whole world marveled and followed the beast.
units.rightText: And I saw one of his heads as though it had been smitten unto death; and his death-stroke was healed: and the whole earth wondered after the beast;

units.leftText: They worshiped the dragon who had given authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast, and who can wage war against it?”
units.rightText: and they worshipped the dragon, because he gave his authority unto the beast; and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? and who is able to war with him?

units.leftText: The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.
units.rightText: and there was given to him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and there was given to him authority to continue forty and two months.

units.leftText: And the beast opened its mouth to speak blasphemies against God and to slander His name and His tabernacle — those who dwell in heaven.
units.rightText: And he opened his mouth for blasphemies against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, even them that dwell in the heaven.

units.leftText: Then the beast was permitted to wage war against the saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
units.rightText: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and there was given to him authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.

units.leftText: And all who dwell on the earth will worship the beast — all whose names have not been written from the foundation of the world in the Book of Life belonging to the Lamb who was slain.
units.rightText: And all that dwell on the earth shall worship him, every one whose name hath not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb that hath been slain.
leftNotes: 13:8 Or written in the Book of Life belonging to the Lamb who was slain from the foundation of the world.

units.leftText: He who has an ear, let him hear:
units.rightText: If any man hath an ear, let him hear.

units.leftText: “If anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity he will go; if anyone is to die by the sword, by the sword he must be killed.” Here is a call for the perseverance and faith of the saints. The Beast from the Earth
units.rightText: If any man is for captivity, into captivity he goeth: if any man shall kill with the sword, with the sword must he be killed. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
leftNotes: 13:10 NE, WH, and BYZ if anyone kills
13:10 See Jeremiah 15:2|JER 15:2*.

units.leftText: Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth. This beast had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
units.rightText: And I saw another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like unto a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.

units.leftText: And this beast exercised all the authority of the first beast and caused the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose mortal wound had been healed.
units.rightText: And he exerciseth all the authority of the first beast in his sight. And he maketh the earth and them that dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose death-stroke was healed.

units.leftText: And the second beast performed great signs, even causing fire from heaven to come down to earth in the presence of the people.
units.rightText: And he doeth great signs, that he should even make fire to come down out of heaven upon the earth in the sight of men.

units.leftText: Because of the signs it was given to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived those who dwell on the earth, telling them to make an image to the beast that had been wounded by the sword and yet had lived.
units.rightText: And he deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by reason of the signs which it was given him to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast who hath the stroke of the sword and lived.

units.leftText: The second beast was permitted to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship it to be killed. The Mark of the Beast
units.rightText: And it was given unto him to give breath to it, even to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as should not worship the image of the beast should be killed.

units.leftText: And the second beast required all people, small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead,
units.rightText: And he causeth all, the small and the great, and the rich and the poor, and the free and the bond, that there be given them a mark on their right hand, or upon their forehead;

units.leftText: so that no one could buy or sell unless he had the mark — the name of the beast or the number of its name.
units.rightText: and that no man should be able to buy or to sell, save he that hath the mark, even the name of the beast or the number of his name.

units.leftText: Here is a call for wisdom: Let the one who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and that number is 666.
units.rightText: Here is wisdom. He that hath understanding, let him count the number of the beast; for it is the number of a man: and his number is Six hundred and sixty and six.
leftNotes: 13:18 Some manuscripts 616

units.leftText: Then I looked and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with Him 144,000 who had His name and His Father’s name written on their foreheads.
units.rightText: And I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on the mount Zion, and with him a hundred and forty and four thousand, having his name, and the name of his Father, written on their foreheads.

units.leftText: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of many waters and the loud rumbling of thunder. And the sound I heard was like harpists strumming their harps.
units.rightText: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and the voice which I heard was as the voice of harpers harping with their harps:

units.leftText: And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. And no one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.
units.rightText: and they sing as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four living creatures and the elders: and no man could learn the song save the hundred and forty and four thousand, even they that had been purchased out of the earth.

units.leftText: These are the ones who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever He goes. They have been redeemed from among men as firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.
units.rightText: These are they that were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they that follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were purchased from among men, to be the firstfruits unto God and unto the Lamb.

units.leftText: And no lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless. The Three Angels and Babylon’s Fall
