units.rightText: And in their mouth was found no lie: they are without blemish.
leftNotes: 14:5 TR includes before the throne of God.

units.leftText: Then I saw another angel flying overhead, with the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth — to every nation and tribe and tongue and people.
units.rightText: And I saw another angel flying in mid heaven, having eternal good tidings to proclaim unto them that dwell on the earth, and unto every nation and tribe and tongue and people;

units.leftText: And he said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come. Worship the One who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters.”
units.rightText: and he saith with a great voice, Fear God, and give him glory; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made the heaven and the earth and sea and fountains of waters.

units.leftText: Then a second angel followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, who has made all the nations drink the wine of the passion of her immorality.”
units.rightText: And another, a second angel, followed, saying, Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, that hath made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.
leftNotes: 14:8 See Isaiah 21:9|ISA 21:9* and Revelation 18:2.

units.leftText: And a third angel followed them, calling out in a loud voice, “If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand,
units.rightText: And another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, If any man worshippeth the beast and his image, and receiveth a mark on his forehead, or upon his hand,

units.leftText: he too will drink the wine of God’s anger, poured undiluted into the cup of His wrath. And he will be tormented in fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.
units.rightText: he also shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:

units.leftText: And the smoke of their torment rises forever and ever. Day and night there is no rest for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name.”
units.rightText: and the smoke of their torment goeth up for ever and ever; and they have no rest day and night, they that worship the beast and his image, and whoso receiveth the mark of his name.

units.leftText: Here is a call for the perseverance of the saints, who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
units.rightText: Here is the patience of the saints, they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

units.leftText: And I heard a voice from heaven telling me to write, “Blessed are the dead — those who die in the Lord from this moment on.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “they will rest from their labors, for their deeds will follow them.” The Harvest of the Earth
units.rightText: And I heard a voice from heaven saying, Write, Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from henceforth: yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labors; for their works follow with them.

units.leftText: And I looked and saw a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was One like the Son of Man, with a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand.
units.rightText: And I saw, and behold, a white cloud; and on the cloud I saw one sitting like unto a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
leftNotes: 14:14 Or one like a son of man; see Daniel 7:13|DAN 7:13*.

units.leftText: Then another angel came out of the temple, crying out in a loud voice to the One seated on the cloud, “Swing Your sickle and reap, because the time has come to harvest, for the crop of the earth is ripe.”
units.rightText: And another angel came out from the temple, crying with a great voice to him that sat on the cloud, Send forth thy sickle, and reap: for the hour to reap is come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.

units.leftText: So the One seated on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
units.rightText: And he that sat on the cloud cast his sickle upon the earth; and the earth was reaped.

units.leftText: Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.
units.rightText: And another angel came out from the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.

units.leftText: Still another angel, with authority over the fire, came from the altar and called out in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle, “Swing your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the vine of the earth, because its grapes are ripe.”
units.rightText: And another angel came out from the altar, he that hath power over fire; and he called with a great voice to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Send forth thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.

units.leftText: So the angel swung his sickle over the earth and gathered the grapes of the earth, and he threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.
units.rightText: And the angel cast his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth, and cast it into the winepress, the great winepress, of the wrath of God.

units.leftText: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and the blood that flowed from it rose as high as the bridles of the horses for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
units.rightText: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and there came out blood from the winepress, even unto the bridles of the horses, as far as a thousand and six hundred furlongs.
leftNotes: 14:20 1,600 stadia is approximately 184 miles or 296 kilometers.

units.leftText: Then I saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven: seven angels with the seven final plagues, with which the wrath of God is completed.
units.rightText: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having seven plagues, which are the last, for in them is finished the wrath of God.

units.leftText: And I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, beside which stood those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name. They were holding harps from God,
units.rightText: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire; and them that come off victorious from the beast, and from his image, and from the number of his name, standing by the sea of glass, having harps of God.

units.leftText: and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!
units.rightText: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, O Lord God, the Almighty; righteous and true are thy ways, thou King of the ages.
leftNotes: 15:3 SBL and WH King of the ages; TR King of the saints

units.leftText: Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.” Preparation for Judgment
units.rightText: Who shall not fear, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy; for all the nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy righteous acts have been made manifest.

units.leftText: After this I looked, and the temple — the tabernacle of the Testimony — was opened in heaven.
units.rightText: And after these things I saw, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:

units.leftText: And out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues, dressed in clean and bright linen and girded with golden sashes around their chests.
units.rightText: and there came out from the temple the seven angels that had the seven plagues, arrayed with precious stone, pure and bright, and girt about their breasts with golden girdles.

units.leftText: Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
units.rightText: And one of the four living creatures gave unto the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.

units.leftText: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power; and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
units.rightText: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and none was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels should be finished.

units.leftText: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, “Go, pour out on the earth the seven bowls of God’s wrath.”
units.rightText: And I heard a great voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, Go ye, and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God into the earth.

units.leftText: So the first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth, and loathsome, malignant sores broke out on those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.
units.rightText: And the first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth; and it became a noisome and grievous sore upon the men that had the mark of the beast, and that worshipped his image.

units.leftText: And the second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it turned to blood like that of the dead, and every living thing in the sea died.
units.rightText: And the second poured out his bowl into the sea; and it became blood as of a dead man; and every living soul died, even the things that were in the sea.

units.leftText: And the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they turned to blood.
units.rightText: And the third poured out his bowl into the rivers and the fountains of the waters; and it became blood.

units.leftText: And I heard the angel of the waters say: “Righteous are You, O Holy One, who is and was, because You have brought these judgments.
units.rightText: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, Righteous art thou, who art and who wast, thou Holy One, because thou didst thus judge:

units.leftText: For they have spilled the blood of saints and prophets, and You have given them blood to drink, as they deserve.”
units.rightText: for they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and blood hast thou given them to drink: they are worthy.

units.leftText: And I heard the altar reply: “Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are Your judgments.”
units.rightText: And I heard the altar saying, Yea, O Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.

units.leftText: Then the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given power to scorch the people with fire.
units.rightText: And the fourth poured out his bowl upon the sun; and it was given unto it to scorch men with fire.

units.leftText: And the people were scorched by intense heat, and they cursed the name of God, who had authority over these plagues. Yet they did not repent and give Him glory.
units.rightText: And men were scorched with great heat: and they blasphemed the name of God who hath the power over these plagues; and they repented not to give him glory.

units.leftText: And the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness, and men began to gnaw their tongues in anguish
units.rightText: And the fifth poured out his bowl upon the throne of the beast; and his kingdom was darkened; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,

units.leftText: and curse the God of heaven for their pains and sores. Yet they did not repent of their deeds.
units.rightText: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores; and they repented not of their works.

units.leftText: And the sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings of the East.
units.rightText: And the sixth poured out his bowl upon the great river, the river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way might be made ready for the kings that come from the sunrising.

units.leftText: And I saw three unclean spirits that looked like frogs coming out of the mouths of the dragon, the beast, and the false prophet.
units.rightText: And I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, as it were frogs:

units.leftText: These are demonic spirits that perform signs and go out to all the kings of the earth, to assemble them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty.
units.rightText: for they are spirits of demons, working signs; which go forth unto the kings of the whole world, to gather them together unto the war of the great day of God, the Almighty.

units.leftText: “Behold, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who remains awake and clothed, so that he will not go naked and let his shame be exposed.”
units.rightText: (Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.)

units.leftText: And they assembled the kings in the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon. The Seventh Bowl of Wrath
units.rightText: And they gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew Har-Magedon.

units.leftText: Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came from the throne in the temple, saying, “It is done!”
units.rightText: And the seventh poured out his bowl upon the air; and there came forth a great voice out of the temple, from the throne, saying, It is done:

units.leftText: And there were flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, and a great earthquake the likes of which had not occurred since men were upon the earth — so mighty was the great quake.
units.rightText: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since there were men upon the earth, so great an earthquake, so mighty.

units.leftText: The great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. And God remembered Babylon the great and gave her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath.
units.rightText: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

units.leftText: Then every island fled, and no mountain could be found.
units.rightText: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

units.leftText: And great hailstones weighing almost a hundred pounds each rained down on them from above. And men cursed God for the plague of hail, because it was so horrendous.
units.rightText: And great hail, every stone about the weight of a talent, cometh down out of heaven upon men: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof is exceeding great.
leftNotes: 16:21 Greek great hail as of a talent; that is, hailstones weighing approximately 75.4 pounds or 34.2 kilograms each

units.leftText: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits on many waters.
units.rightText: And there came one of the seven angels that had the seven bowls, and spake with me, saying, Come hither, I will show thee the judgment of the great harlot that sitteth upon many waters;

units.leftText: The kings of the earth were immoral with her, and those who dwell on the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her immorality.”
units.rightText: with whom the kings of the earth committed fornication, and they that dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her fornication.

units.leftText: And the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness, where I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.
units.rightText: And he carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness: and I saw a woman sitting upon a scarlet-colored beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.

units.leftText: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls. She held in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of her sexual immorality.
units.rightText: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stone and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations, even the unclean things of her fornication,

units.leftText: And on her forehead a mysterious name was written: BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH. The Mystery Explained
units.rightText: and upon her forehead a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE HARLOTS AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.

units.leftText: I could see that the woman was drunk with the blood of the saints and witnesses for Jesus. And I was utterly amazed at the sight of her.
units.rightText: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. And when I saw her, I wondered with a great wonder.

units.leftText: “Why are you so amazed?” said the angel. “I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
units.rightText: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou wonder? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and the ten horns.

units.leftText: The beast that you saw — it was, and now is no more, but is about to come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction. And those who dwell on the earth whose names were not written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see the beast that was, and is not, and yet will be.
units.rightText: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss, and to go into perdition. And they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, they whose name hath not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast, how that he was, and is not, and shall come.

units.leftText: This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
units.rightText: Here is the mind that hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth:

units.leftText: There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come. But when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.
units.rightText: and they are seven kings; the five are fallen, the one is, the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a little while.

units.leftText: The beast that was, and now is not, is an eighth king, who belongs to the other seven and is going into destruction.
units.rightText: And the beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goeth into perdition.

units.leftText: The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but will receive one hour of authority as kings along with the beast.
units.rightText: And the ten horns that thou sawest are ten kings, who have received no kingdom as yet; but they receive authority as kings, with the beast, for one hour.

units.leftText: These kings have one purpose: to yield their power and authority to the beast. The Victory of the Lamb
units.rightText: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority unto the beast.

units.leftText: They will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will triumph over them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and He will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones.”
units.rightText: These shall war against the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them, for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings; and they also shall overcome that are with him, called and chosen and faithful.

units.leftText: Then the angel said to me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute was seated, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.
units.rightText: And he saith unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the harlot sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.

units.leftText: And the ten horns and the beast that you saw will hate the prostitute. They will leave her desolate and naked, and they will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
units.rightText: And the ten horns which thou sawest, and the beast, these shall hate the harlot, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and shall burn her utterly with fire.

units.leftText: For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose by uniting to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
units.rightText: For God did put in their hearts to do his mind, and to come to one mind, and to give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.

units.leftText: And the woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.”
units.rightText: And the woman whom thou sawest is the great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.

units.leftText: After this I saw another angel descending from heaven with great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his glory.
units.rightText: After these things I saw another angel coming down out of heaven, having great authority; and the earth was lightened with his glory.

units.leftText: And he cried out in a mighty voice: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a lair for demons and a haunt for every unclean spirit, every unclean bird, and every detestable beast.
units.rightText: And he cried with a mighty voice, saying, Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and is become a habitation of demons, and a hold of every unclean spirit, and a hold of every unclean and hateful bird.
leftNotes: 18:2 See Isaiah 21:9|ISA 21:9* and Revelation 14:8.
18:2 NE, WH, BYZ, and TR a haunt for every unclean spirit and every unclean and detestable bird.

units.leftText: All the nations have drunk the wine of the passion of her immorality. The kings of the earth were immoral with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown wealthy from the extravagance of her luxury.”
units.rightText: For by the wine of the wrath of her fornication all the nations are fallen; and the kings of the earth committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth waxed rich by the power of her wantonness.
leftNotes: 18:3 SBL and WH have fallen by

units.leftText: Then I heard another voice from heaven say: “Come out of her, My people, so that you will not share in her sins or contract any of her plagues.
units.rightText: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come forth, my people, out of her, that ye have no fellowship with her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues:
leftNotes: 18:4 See Jeremiah 51:45|JER 51:45*.

units.leftText: For her sins are piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities.
units.rightText: for her sins have reached even unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.

units.leftText: Give back to her as she has done to others; pay her back double for what she has done; mix her a double portion in her own cup.
units.rightText: Render unto her even as she rendered, and double unto her the double according to her works: in the cup which she mingled, mingle unto her double.

units.leftText: As much as she has glorified herself and lived in luxury, give her the same measure of torment and grief. In her heart she says, ‘I sit as queen; I am not a widow and will never see grief.’
units.rightText: How much soever she glorified herself, and waxed wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall in no wise see mourning.

units.leftText: Therefore her plagues will come in one day — death and grief and famine — and she will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.” Lament over Babylon
units.rightText: Therefore in one day shall her plagues come, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire; for strong is the Lord God who judged her.

units.leftText: Then the kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived in luxury with her will weep and wail at the sight of the smoke rising from the fire that consumes her.
units.rightText: And the kings of the earth, who committed fornication and lived wantonly with her, shall weep and wail over her, when they look upon the smoke of her burning,
leftNotes: 18:9 Literally when they see the smoke of her burning; also in verse 18

units.leftText: In fear of her torment, they will stand at a distance and cry out: “Woe, woe to the great city, the mighty city of Babylon! For in a single hour your judgment has come.”
units.rightText: standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.

units.leftText: And the merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her, because there is no one left to buy their cargo —
units.rightText: And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no man buyeth their merchandise any more;

units.leftText: cargo of gold, silver, precious stones, and pearls; of fine linen, purple, silk, and scarlet; of all kinds of citron wood and every article of ivory, precious wood, bronze, iron, and marble;
units.rightText: merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stone, and pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet; and all thyine wood, and every vessel of ivory, and every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

units.leftText: of cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, and frankincense; of wine, olive oil, fine flour, and wheat; of cattle, sheep, horses, and carriages; of bodies and souls of slaves.
units.rightText: and cinnamon, and spice, and incense, and ointment, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and cattle, and sheep; and merchandise of horses and chariots and slaves; and souls of men.

units.leftText: And they will say: “The fruit of your soul’s desire has departed from you; all your luxury and splendor have vanished, never to be seen again.”
units.rightText: And the fruits which thy soul lusted after are gone from thee, and all things that were dainty and sumptuous are perished from thee, and men shall find them no more at all.
leftNotes: 18:14 Literally And:

units.leftText: The merchants who sold these things and gained their wealth from her will stand at a distance, in fear of her torment. They will weep and mourn,
units.rightText: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning;

units.leftText: saying: “Woe, woe to the great city, clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls!
units.rightText: saying, Woe, woe, the great city, she that was arrayed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stone and pearl!

units.leftText: For in a single hour such fabulous wealth has been destroyed!”
units.rightText: for in one hour so great riches is made desolate. And every shipmaster, and every one that saileth any whither, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood afar off,

units.leftText: and cry out at the sight of the smoke rising from the fire that consumes her. “What city was ever like this great city?” they will exclaim.
units.rightText: and cried out as they looked upon the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like the great city?

units.leftText: Then they will throw dust on their heads as they weep and mourn and cry out: “Woe, woe to the great city, where all who had ships on the sea were enriched by her wealth! For in a single hour she has been destroyed.”
units.rightText: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, Woe, woe, the great city, wherein all that had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.

units.leftText: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her. The Doom of Babylon
units.rightText: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye saints, and ye apostles, and ye prophets; for God hath judged your judgment on her.

units.leftText: Then a mighty angel picked up a stone the size of a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying: “With such violence the great city of Babylon will be cast down, never to be seen again.
units.rightText: And a strong angel took up a stone as it were a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with a mighty fall shall Babylon, the great city, be cast down, and shall be found no more at all.

units.leftText: And the sound of harpists and musicians, of flute players and trumpeters, will never ring out in you again. Nor will any craftsmen of any trade be found in you again, nor the sound of a millstone be heard in you again.
units.rightText: And the voice of harpers and minstrels and flute-players and trumpeters shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft, shall be found any more at all in thee; and the voice of a mill shall be heard no more at all in thee;

units.leftText: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again, and the voices of a bride and bridegroom will never call out in you again. For your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because all the nations were deceived by your sorcery.”
units.rightText: and the light of a lamp shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the princes of the earth; for with thy sorcery were all the nations deceived.

units.leftText: And there was found in her the blood of prophets and saints, and of all who had been slain on the earth.
units.rightText: And in her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all that have been slain upon the earth.

units.leftText: After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!
units.rightText: After these things I heard as it were a great voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, Hallelujah; Salvation, and glory, and power, belong to our God:
leftNotes: 19:1 Hallelujah is a transliteration of the Hebrew Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verses 3, 4, and 6.

units.leftText: For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. He has avenged the blood of His servants that was poured out by her hand.”
units.rightText: for true and righteous are his judgments; for he hath judged the great harlot, her that corrupted the earth with her fornication, and he hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.

units.leftText: And a second time they called out: “Hallelujah! Her smoke rises forever and ever.”
units.rightText: And a second time they say, Hallelujah. And her smoke goeth up for ever and ever.

units.leftText: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying: “Amen, Hallelujah!”
units.rightText: And the four and twenty elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshipped God that sitteth on the throne, saying, Amen; Hallelujah.

units.leftText: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!” The Marriage of the Lamb
units.rightText: And a voice came forth from the throne, saying, Give praise to our God, all ye his servants, ye that fear him, the small and the great.

units.leftText: And I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out: “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
units.rightText: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunders, saying, Hallelujah: for the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigneth.
leftNotes: 19:6 SBL, BYZ, and TR the Lord God

units.leftText: Let us rejoice and be glad and give Him the glory. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.
units.rightText: Let us rejoice and be exceeding glad, and let us give the glory unto him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.

units.leftText: She was given clothing of fine linen, bright and pure.” For the fine linen she wears is the righteous acts of the saints.
units.rightText: And it was given unto her that she should array herself in fine linen, bright and pure: for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

units.leftText: Then the angel told me to write, “Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.” And he said to me, “These are the true words of God.”
units.rightText: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they that are bidden to the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are true words of God.

units.leftText: So I fell at his feet to worship him. But he told me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who rely on the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.” The Rider on the White Horse
units.rightText: And I fell down before his feet to worship him. And he saith unto me, See thou do it not: I am a fellow-servant with thee and with thy brethren that hold the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.

units.leftText: Then I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse. And its rider is called Faithful and True. With righteousness He judges and wages war.
units.rightText: And I saw the heaven opened; and behold, a white horse, and he that sat thereon called Faithful and True; and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.

units.leftText: He has eyes like blazing fire, and many royal crowns on His head. He has a name written on Him that only He Himself knows.
units.rightText: And his eyes are a flame of fire, and upon his head are many diadems; and he hath a name written which no one knoweth but he himself.

units.leftText: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and His name is The Word of God.
units.rightText: And he is arrayed in a garment sprinkled with blood: and his name is called The Word of God.
leftNotes: 19:13 WH sprinkled with blood

units.leftText: The armies of heaven, dressed in fine linen, white and pure, follow Him on white horses.
units.rightText: And the armies which are in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and pure.

units.leftText: And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
units.rightText: And out of his mouth proceedeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.
leftNotes: 19:15 See Psalm 2:9|PSA 2:9* (see also LXX).

units.leftText: And He has a name written on His robe and on His thigh: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS. Defeat of the Beast and False Prophet
units.rightText: And he hath on his garment and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.

units.leftText: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he cried out in a loud voice to all the birds flying overhead, “Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
units.rightText: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in mid heaven, Come and be gathered together unto the great supper of God;

units.leftText: so that you may eat the flesh of kings and commanders and mighty men, of horses and riders, of everyone slave and free, small and great.”
units.rightText: that ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of them that sit thereon, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, and small and great.

units.leftText: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies assembled to wage war against the One seated on the horse, and against His army.
units.rightText: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat upon the horse, and against his army.

units.leftText: But the beast was captured along with the false prophet, who on its behalf had performed signs deceiving those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. Both the beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.
units.rightText: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought the signs in his sight, wherewith he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast and them that worshipped his image: they two were cast alive into the lake of fire that burneth with brimstone:

units.leftText: And the rest were killed with the sword that proceeded from the mouth of the One seated on the horse. And all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.
units.rightText: and the rest were killed with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, even the sword which came forth out of his mouth: and all the birds were filled with their flesh.

units.leftText: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven with the key to the Abyss, holding in his hand a great chain.
units.rightText: And I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

units.leftText: He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.
units.rightText: And he laid hold on the dragon, the old serpent, which is the Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years,

units.leftText: And he threw him into the Abyss, shut it, and sealed it over him, so that he could not deceive the nations until the thousand years were complete. After that, he must be released for a brief period of time.
units.rightText: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it, and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more, until the thousand years should be finished: after this he must be loosed for a little time.

units.leftText: Then I saw the thrones, and those seated on them had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their foreheads or hands. And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
units.rightText: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus, and for the word of God, and such as worshipped not the beast, neither his image, and received not the mark upon their forehead and upon their hand; and they lived, and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

units.leftText: The rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years were complete. This is the first resurrection.
units.rightText: The rest of the dead lived not until the thousand years should be finished. This is the first resurrection.

units.leftText: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection! The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with Him for a thousand years. Satan Cast into the Lake of Fire
units.rightText: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: over these the second death hath no power; but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.

units.leftText: When the thousand years are complete, Satan will be released from his prison,
units.rightText: And when the thousand years are finished, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,

units.leftText: and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth — Gog and Magog — to assemble them for battle. Their number is like the sand of the seashore.
units.rightText: and shall come forth to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.

units.leftText: And they marched across the broad expanse of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. But fire came down from heaven and consumed them.
units.rightText: And they went up over the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down out of heaven, and devoured them.
leftNotes: 20:9 BYZ and TR came down from God out of heaven

units.leftText: And the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, into which the beast and the false prophet had already been thrown. There they will be tormented day and night forever and ever. Judgment before the Great White Throne
units.rightText: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where are also the beast and the false prophet; and they shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.

units.leftText: Then I saw a great white throne and the One seated on it. Earth and heaven fled from His presence, and no place was found for them.
units.rightText: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat upon it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.

units.leftText: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne.
units.rightText: And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne; and books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

units.leftText: The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hades gave up their dead, and each one was judged according to his deeds.
units.rightText: And the sea gave up the dead that were in it; and death and Hades gave up the dead that were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.

units.leftText: Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death — the lake of fire.
units.rightText: And death and Hades were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death, even the lake of fire.

units.leftText: And if anyone was found whose name was not written in the Book of Life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.
units.rightText: And if any was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

units.leftText: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.
units.rightText: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth are passed away; and the sea is no more.
leftNotes: 21:1 See Isaiah 65:17|ISA 65:17* and Isaiah 66:22 (see also LXX).

units.leftText: I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
units.rightText: And I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, made ready as a bride adorned for her husband.

units.leftText: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying: “Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man, and He will dwell with them. They will be His people, and God Himself will be with them as their God.
units.rightText: And I heard a great voice out of the throne saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he shall dwell with them, and they shall be his peoples, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God:
leftNotes: 21:3 SBL, NE, WH, and BYZ God Himself will be with them.

units.leftText: ‘He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,’ and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away.”
units.rightText: and he shall wipe away every tear from their eyes; and death shall be no more; neither shall there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more: the first things are passed away.

units.leftText: And the One seated on the throne said, “Behold, I make all things new.” Then He said, “Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.”
units.rightText: And he that sitteth on the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he saith, Write: for these words are faithful and true.

units.leftText: And He told me, “It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give freely from the spring of the water of life.
units.rightText: And he said unto me, They are come to pass. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.

units.leftText: The one who overcomes will inherit all things, and I will be his God, and he will be My son.
units.rightText: He that overcometh shall inherit these things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.

units.leftText: But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.” The New Jerusalem
units.rightText: But for the fearful, and unbelieving, and abominable, and murderers, and fornicators, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, their part shall be in the lake that burneth with fire and brimstone; which is the second death.

units.leftText: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls full of the seven final plagues came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”
units.rightText: And there came one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls, who were laden with the seven last plagues; and he spake with me, saying, Come hither, I will show thee the bride, the wife of the Lamb.

units.leftText: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God,
units.rightText: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the holy city Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

units.leftText: shining with the glory of God. Its radiance was like a most precious jewel, like a jasper, as clear as crystal.
units.rightText: having the glory of God: her light was like unto a stone most precious, as it were a jasper stone, clear as crystal:

units.leftText: The city had a great and high wall with twelve gates inscribed with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel, and twelve angels at the gates.
units.rightText: having a wall great and high; having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels; and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:

units.leftText: There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.
units.rightText: on the east were three gates; and on the north three gates; and on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.

units.leftText: The wall of the city had twelve foundations bearing the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
units.rightText: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

units.leftText: The angel who spoke with me had a golden measuring rod to measure the city and its gates and walls.
units.rightText: And he that spake with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.

units.leftText: The city lies foursquare, with its width the same as its length. And he measured the city with the rod, and all its dimensions were equal — 12,000 stadia in length and width and height.
units.rightText: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length thereof is as great as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs: the length and the breadth and the height thereof are equal.
leftNotes: 21:16 12,000 stadia is approximately 1,380 miles or 2,220 kilometers.

units.leftText: And he measured its wall to be 144 cubits, by the human measure the angel was using.
units.rightText: And he measured the wall thereof, a hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.
leftNotes: 21:17 144 cubits is approximately 216 feet or 65.8 meters. The measure could indicate either height or thickness.

units.leftText: The wall was made of jasper, and the city itself of pure gold, as pure as glass.
units.rightText: And the building of the wall thereof was jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto pure glass.

units.leftText: The foundations of the city walls were adorned with every kind of precious stone: The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
units.rightText: The foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;

units.leftText: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
units.rightText: the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprase; the eleventh, jacinth; the twelfth, amethyst.

units.leftText: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, with each gate consisting of a single pearl. The main street of the city was pure gold, as clear as glass.
units.rightText: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the several gates was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.

units.leftText: But I saw no temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
units.rightText: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God the Almighty, and the Lamb, are the temple thereof.

units.leftText: And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp.
units.rightText: And the city hath no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine upon it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the lamp thereof is the Lamb.

units.leftText: By its light the nations will walk, and into it the kings of the earth will bring their glory.
units.rightText: And the nations shall walk amidst the light thereof: and the kings of the earth bring their glory into it.
leftNotes: 21:24 BYZ and TR include and honor.

units.leftText: Its gates will never be shut at the end of the day, because there will be no night there.
units.rightText: And the gates thereof shall in no wise be shut by day (for there shall be no night there):

units.leftText: And into the city will be brought the glory and honor of the nations.
units.rightText: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it:

units.leftText: But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who practices an abomination or a lie, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.
units.rightText: and there shall in no wise enter into it anything unclean, or he that maketh an abomination and a lie: but only they that are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

units.leftText: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
units.rightText: And he showed me a river of water of life, bright as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

units.leftText: down the middle of the main street of the city. On either side of the river stood a tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruit and yielding a fresh crop for each month. And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.
units.rightText: in the midst of the street thereof. And on this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve manner of fruits, yielding its fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

units.leftText: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within the city, and His servants will worship Him.
units.rightText: And there shall be no curse any more: and the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be therein: and his servants shall serve him;

units.leftText: They will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads.
units.rightText: and they shall see his face; and his name shall be on their foreheads.

units.leftText: There will be no more night in the city, and they will have no need for the light of a lamp or of the sun. For the Lord God will shine on them, and they will reign forever and ever. Jesus Is Coming
units.rightText: And there shall be night no more; and they need no light of lamp, neither light of sun; for the Lord God shall give them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

units.leftText: Then the angel said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show His servants what must soon take place.”
units.rightText: And he said unto me, These words are faithful and true: and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent his angel to show unto his servants the things which must shortly come to pass.
leftNotes: 22:6 Or suddenly or quickly; similarly in verses 7, 12, and 20

units.leftText: “Behold, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book. ”
units.rightText: And behold, I come quickly. Blessed is he that keepeth the words of the prophecy of this book.
leftNotes: 22:7 Or scroll; also in verses 9, 10, 18, 19

units.leftText: And I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.
units.rightText: And I John am he that heard and saw these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel that showed me these things.

units.leftText: But he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!”
units.rightText: And he saith unto me, See thou do it not: I am a fellow-servant with thee and with thy brethren the prophets, and with them that keep the words of this book: worship God.

units.leftText: Then he told me, “Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book, because the time is near.
units.rightText: And he saith unto me, Seal not up the words of the prophecy of this book; for the time is at hand.

units.leftText: Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile; let the righteous continue to practice righteousness, and the holy continue to be holy.”
units.rightText: He that is unrighteous, let him do unrighteousness still: and he that is filthy, let him be made filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him do righteousness still: and he that is holy, let him be made holy still.

units.leftText: “Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done.
units.rightText: Behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to render to each man according as his work is.

units.leftText: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.”
units.rightText: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.

units.leftText: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by its gates.
units.rightText: Blessed are they that wash their robes, that they may have the right to come to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.
leftNotes: 22:14 BYZ and TR Blessed are those who do His commandments

units.leftText: But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
units.rightText: Without are the dogs, and the sorcerers, and the fornicators, and the murderers, and the idolaters, and every one that loveth and maketh a lie.

units.leftText: “I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.”
units.rightText: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things for the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright, the morning star.

units.leftText: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Let the one who hears say, “Come!” And let the one who is thirsty come, and the one who desires the water of life drink freely. Nothing May Be Added or Removed
units.rightText: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And he that heareth, let him say, Come. And he that is athirst, let him come: he that will, let him take the water of life freely.

units.leftText: I testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book: If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book.
units.rightText: I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto them, God shall add unto him the plagues which are written in this book:

units.leftText: And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city, which are described in this book.
units.rightText: and if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

units.leftText: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
units.rightText: He who testifieth these things saith, Yea: I come quickly. Amen: come, Lord Jesus.

units.leftText: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen.
units.rightText: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with the saints. Amen.
leftNotes: 22:21 WH and BYZ the Lord Jesus Christ; TR our Lord Jesus Christ
22:21 SBL, WH, NE, and TR do not include the saints.
22:21 SBL, WH, NE, and NA do not include Amen.
